result.document_summary: A portion of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 2 (Nondiscrimination in Contracting complaint procedures and the Small and Local Business Program for public contracts), scraped from a code-publisher page whose URL refers to a San Diego algorithmic rent-pricing division that is not included in this part.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only San Diego Municipal Code provisions on city contracting: nondiscrimination complaints, hearings and remedies (§§ 22.3505-22.3517) and the Small and Local Business Program (§§ 22.3601-22.3604). None of it concerns residential rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application or screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The page URL mentions a Division 11 on anti-competitive automated rent price fixing, but no text of that rule appears in this excerpt, so no rule is extracted.
